MOSS CIRCUIT v19 — Linux x86-64

Extract every file together. Keep MossCircuit.pck beside the executable.
Run ./MossCircuit.x86_64. If your extractor removed the executable permission, restore it with chmod +x MossCircuit.x86_64.

WASD/arrows: move. Space: dash. Esc: pause/back. I: build inventory.
Auto-fire targets nearby enemies. Tab/Shift+Tab and Enter/Space navigate menus.
Display settings are session-only; preferences are not saved to disk in this prototype.

The exact Linux executable/PCK passed finite native-window controls, shop, inventory, Rooms victory and retry checks. That is not human balance or full-game certification. Cloud ALSA audio-device failure fell back to dummy audio; audio was not validated. Cloud llvmpipe also warned about VSync control. Windows received PE/resource inspection only.

Godot engine and third-party license notices accompany this archive. They do not grant a new license to the game source/artwork. ARTIFACT_SHA256.json covers all other files; the delivery receipt separately records this ZIP hash.
